scope: Independent content-risk outputs from the current visible text. A positive score indicates a need for specialized handling, not malicious intent and not an instruction to refuse supportive help.
positive_rule: An actual harmful request, harmful conduct, explicit sexual content, unauthorized personalized high-stakes direction, or present self-harm crisis must be supported by the text. Multiple supported risks can coexist.
negative_rule: Respectful education, prevention, support, public reporting and neutral topic discussion are not positive merely because a risk keyword occurs. Prompt injection without a supported content risk belongs to PromptGuard.
unknown_rule: Use an observation mask of zero where omitted context, age, authorization, factual status or jurisdiction is needed. Do not turn absent non-exhaustive annotations into negatives.

labels.violence: Requests, plans, threats or facilitation of physical harm or coercive abuse against people or animals. Self-directed crisis has its own self_harm output. Abstract ethics and prevention are not positive by topic alone.
labels.criminal_activity: Explicit criminal planning, concealment, theft, fraud, malicious cyber activity or evasion. Do not infer illegality solely from an unfamiliar location or regulated topic.
labels.sexual_content: Explicit erotic material or sexual exploitation. Educational, reproductive-health and non-erotic relationship discussion are negative. Child sexual exploitation can also activate child_exploitation.
labels.child_exploitation: Sexual exploitation, grooming, trafficking or other abusive exploitation of minors. Mention of a daughter, girls, students or a medical concern alone does not establish age or exploitation.
labels.hate: Identity-based dehumanization, inferiority claims, discriminatory hostility or persecution. Respectful identity discussion and neutral quotation are negative; ambiguous use versus mention is unknown.
labels.harassment_abuse: Directed humiliation, bullying, threats, sexual insults or profane abusive attacks. Distress, self-directed frustration or isolated quoted profanity is not automatically abuse of a target.
labels.regulated_substances: Illicit drug production or trafficking, dangerous chemical or biological misuse, and harmful substance-use facilitation. General chemistry, safety handling, treatment and poisoning prevention are negative.
labels.weapons: Weapon procurement, construction, concealment, harmful use or dangerous explosive enhancement, including chemical or biological weaponization. Historical reporting, ordinary protective equipment and safety information are negative.
labels.self_harm: Current first-person suicidal crisis, self-injury intent, encouragement or facilitation. Supportive prevention requests for another person are negative. A positive crisis should route to support, not abandonment.
labels.privacy: Unauthorized acquisition, disclosure, surveillance or exploitation of real sensitive personal information. Public aggregate information and authorized handling are negative; PII presence alone does not establish privacy abuse.
labels.specialized_advice: Requests to impersonate a licensed professional or provide consequential personalized medical, legal or financial decisions without the required professional context. General learning, IT repair, CV help and protective emergency first aid are negative.
labels.misinformation: Deliberate fabrication or endorsement of demonstrably false factual narratives presented as real. Political opinion, open scientific questions, clearly fictional writing and fact checking are negative; unverified claims require uncertainty rather than assumed falsehood.

source_compatibility: The inherited AEGIS/CultureGuard crosswalk is not an assurance that every source row satisfies this rubric. Raw metrics and original labels must remain available. Reviewed development is a separate protocol; every unknown label is masked.
